content:
Respectful debate can bring people together without asking them to agree on everything.

At Alethical’s Forward Debate, Trent Dilks @trentformn13 and Aaron Brutger (https://brutgerformnsenate.com) discussed the issues facing Minnesota and showed what that can look like. Afterward, attendees praised both candidates, with some calling it the best debate they had seen.

The conversations continued after the debate ended. People spoke positively about the candidates joining the Forward Independence Coalition and their willingness to work across party lines.
https://forwardcoalition.com/candidates

We should be able to disagree on some issues while working together on others. Voters deserve the chance to hear candidates explain their views, answer hard questions and find common ground.

That’s the spirit we want to build on. Alethical will soon share more about our plans for the next election cycle, including debates across Minnesota and practical tools, data and support for candidates of any party, including independents.

Candidates should be able to stand by their principles and compete. Voters should decide who earns their support.

Thank you to Trent Dilks @t.christian101 and Aaron Brutger, and to everyone who attended, asked questions and kept the conversation going.

Watch the full debate on YouTube: tap the link in our bio, choose YouTube, then open “The Forward Debate.”

Also available on our website:
https://www.alethical.com/blog/events/forward-debate-2026

#MinnesotaPolitics #CivilDiscourse #LocalPolitics
